G1716.d: from ἐν and πτύω; to spit at or on:--spit (upon).

G1743.d: from ἐν and δυναμόω; to empower:--enable, (increase in) strength(-en), be (make) strong.

G1805.d: from ἐκ and ἀγοράζω; to buy up, i.e. ransom; figuratively, to rescue from loss (improve opportunity):--redeem.

G1922.d: from ἐπιγινώσκω; recognition, i.e. (by implication) full discernment, acknowledgement:--(ac-)knowledge(-ing, - ment).

G1964.d: from ἐπίορκος; to commit perjury:--forswear self.

G1799.d: neuter of a compound of ἐν and a derivative of ὀπτάνομαι; in the face of (literally or figuratively):--before, in the presence (sight) of, to.

G1872.d: from ἐπί and ἀκολουθέω; to accompany:--follow (after).

G1781.d: from ἐν and the base of τέλος; to enjoin:--(give) charge, (give) command(-ments), injoin.

G1723.d: from ἐν and a derivative of ἀγκάλη; to take in one's arms, i.e. embrace:--take up in arms.

G1893.d: from ἐπί and εἰ; thereupon, i.e. since (of time or cause):--because, else, for that (then, -asmuch as), otherwise, seeing that, since, when.

G1636.d: feminine of a presumed derivative from an obsolete primary; an olive (the tree or the fruit):--olive (berry, tree).

G1702.d: from ἐν and παίζω; to jeer at, i.e. deride:--mock.

G1530.d: from εἰς and (to leap); to rush in:--run (spring) in.

G1758.d: from ἐν and ἔχω; to hold in or upon, i.e. ensnare; by implication, to keep a grudge:--entangle with, have a quarrel against, urge.

G1765.d: from ἐν and ἰσχύω; to invigorate (transitively or reflexively):--strengthen.

G1777.d: from ἐνέχω; liable to (a condition, penalty or imputation):--in danger of, guilty of, subject to.

G1774.d: from ἐν and οἰκέω; to inhabit (figuratively):--dwell in.

G1898.d: from a compound of ἐπί and εἰσάγω; a superintroduction:--bringing in.

G1615.d: from ἐκ and τελέω; to complete fully:--finish.

G1756.d: from ἐν and ἔργον; active, operative:--effectual, powerful.

G1534.d: of uncertain affinity; a particle of succession (in time or logical enumeration), then, moreover:--after that(-ward), furthermore, then. See also ἔπειτα.

G1516.d: from εἰρήνη; pacific; by implication, salutary:--peaceable.

G1869.d: from ἐπί and αἴρω; to raise up (literally or figuratively):--exalt self, poise (lift, take) up.

G1788.d: from ἐν and the base of τροπή; to invert, i.e. (figuratively and reflexively) in a good sense, to respect; or in a bad one, to confound:--regard, (give) reference, shame.

G1988.d: from ἐπί and a presumed derivative of ἵστημι; an appointee over, i.e. commander (teacher):--master.

G1942.d: from ἐπικαλύπτω; a covering, i.e. (figuratively) pretext:--cloke.

G1665.d: of Hebrew origin (אֱלִישֶׁבַע); Elisabet, an Israelitess:--Elisabeth.

G1620.d: from ἐκ and τίθημι; to expose; figuratively, to declare:--cast out, expound.

G1853.d: from ἐκ and ὕπνος; awake:--X out of sleep.

G1717.d: from a compound of ἐν and φαίνω; apparent in self:--manifest, openly.

G1981.d: from ἐπί and σκηνόω; to tent upon, i.e. (figuratively) abide with :--rest upon.

G1539.d: as if from ἕκαστος and τότε; at every time:--always.

G1769.d: from ἐννεύω; dumb (as making signs), i.e. silent from astonishment:--speechless.

G1877.d: from ἐπί and ἀνάγω; to lead up on, i.e. (technical) to put out (to sea); (intransitively) to return:--launch (thrust) out, return.

G1603.d: from ἐκ and πληρόω; to accomplish entirely:--fulfill.

G1965.d: from ἐπί and ὅρκος; on oath, i.e. (falsely) a forswearer:--perjured person.

G1739.d: from a compound of ἐν and a derivative of the base of δῆμος; a housing in (residence), i.e. structure:--building.

G1611.d: from ἐξίστημι; a displacement of the mind, i.e. bewilderment, "ecstasy":--+ be amazed, amazement, astonishment, trance.

G1752.d: of uncertain affinity; on account of:--because, for (cause, sake), (where-)fore, by reason of, that.

G1675.d: from a derivative of Ἕλλην; a Hellenist or Greek-speaking Jew:--Grecian.

G1551.d: from ἐκ and δέχομαι; to accept from some source, i.e. (by implication) to await:--expect, look (tarry) for, wait (for).

G1569.d: from ἐκ and θάμβος; utterly astounded:--greatly wondering.

G1945.d: from ἐπί and κεῖμαι; to rest upon (literally or figuratively):--impose, be instant, (be) laid (there-, up-)on, (when) lay (on), lie (on), press upon.

G1886.d: from ἐπί and an equivalent of αὐλή; a hut over the head, i.e. a dwelling:--habitation.

G1666.d: of Hebrew origin (אֱלִישָׁע); Elissæus, an Israelite:--Elissæus.

G1762.d: contraction for the third person singular present indicative of ἔνειμι; impersonally, there is in or among:--be, (there) is.

G1596.d: adverb from the same as ἑκούσιον; voluntarily:--wilfully, willingly.

G1952.d: from ἐπί and λείπω; to leave upon, i.e. (figuratively) to be insufficient for:--fail.

G1786.d: from ἐν and τόπος; a resident:--of that place.

G1823.d: from ἐκ and ἀστράπτω; to lighten forth, i.e. (figuratively) to be radiant (of very white garments):--glistening.

G1874.d: from ἐπί and the base of ἀκροατής; to listen (intently) to:--hear.

G1661.d: from (an "elephant"); elephantine, i.e. (by implication) composed of ivory:--of ivory.

G1674.d: feminine of Ἕλλην; a Grecian (i.e. non-Jewish) woman:--Greek.

G1621.d: from ἐκ and tinasso (to swing); to shake violently:--shake (off).
